caseNameFull: McClatchy Newspapers v. Noble et ux.

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motion of American Newspaper Publishers Assn, for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Continental T. V., Inc. v. GTE Sylvania Inc., ante, p. 36.
